Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: the mists
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: They come at night and settle, and the people who stay out in them are not always the same afterwards.

Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: ashfall
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: The Ashmounts burn and the sky carries what they throw up. It settles on everything, and it has to be swept.

Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.label: Preservation's gifts
Cosmere.Core.Def.CosmereFeatureDef.description: A bead of lerasium, very rarely, left where somebody will find it. Preservation was always careful with what little he could still spend.
